title: [Part 2] Migrate connection UI metadata to YAML for more providers

- [x] Yes - cursor with claude models

<!--
Generated-by: [Tool Name] following [the guidelines](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/contributing-docs/05_pull_requests.rst#gen-ai-assisted-contributions)
-->

Migrate task execution, DAG processing, and logging providers: git, ssh, sftp, docker, cncf/kubernetes, standard, grpc,
opensearch, datadog, influxdb

Chose providers used for:
- Remote task execution (ssh, sftp, docker, kubernetes)
- DAG/code retrieval (git)
- Standard filesystem and package operations (standard)
- Service communication (grpc)
- Remote logging backends (opensearch, datadog, influxdb)

* When adding dependency, check compliance with the [ASF 3rd Party License Policy](https://www.apache.org/legal/resolved.html#category-x).
* For significant user-facing changes create newsfragment: `{pr_number}.significant.rst` or `{issue_number}.significant.rst`, in [airflow-core/newsfragments](https://github.com/apache/airflow/tree/main/airflow-core/newsfragments).
